Description: Smart TechOne is the technology and innovation arm of the HRL Engineering, one of Pakistan's established engineering and infrastructure groups. Registered as an STZA Zone Enterprise, the company applies that engineering lineage to the digital layer of the city. Smart TechOne leads digital transformation & innovation for Capital Smart City and Lahore Smart City across the full delivery chain. We specify and deploy the sensing and connectivity layer, we build the software that runs on top of it, and we operate the command centre daily. Most smart city suppliers deliver a single product line: a meter, a camera, a parking sensor or a dashboard. The city then ends up administering forty disconnected systems. Smart TechOne begins instead with one platform and selects hardware that fits it.That platform is SmartCity OS, ECHO, and its centre is a live 4D Digital Twin of the city. Every pole, meter, plot, building, lift, valve and vehicle exists in the twin as an object with history, state and behaviour, streaming from more than 25 operational modules across energy, water, sewerage, environment, buildings, safety, mobility and town planning. Because every module reports into the same model, a single event can drive several systems at once. A fire alarm releases the nearest barrier, recalls the lift, pushes the camera feed to the command centre, routes the fire vehicle and notifies the block. Operators replay incidents, and simulate an action such as closing a valve or releasing a sector before committing to it. ECHO AI runs a seven-day predictive horizon over the same twin for demand forecasting, leak and anomaly detection, computer vision and maintenance prediction. Critically, the city is planned on the model that operates it, so an approved plot, a planted avenue and a sewer segment remain the same record from proposal to sensor.The stack is proven in an occupied city before it is offered to the next. Each module is commissioned and hardened in live operation at Capital Smart City and Lahore Smart City, run from the Command Centre and developed at the Silicon Village Incubation Center. Delivered outcomes are measured in revenue assurance, operating cost, public safety, asset lifecycle and planning integrity, against a 99.97% platform availability target and support in 7 languages. Smart TechOne is available to municipal authorities, master developers and public sector clients as a complete platform or module by module, with an operate and support model in which our teams run the platform rather than hand over a system and a manual.
